feeds.title: Thy Black Man
feeds.description: This blog was created to unite black men and remind us of our brotherhood and value as men in this society. This blog is for all black men, regardless of your vocation in life.

feeds.title: Urban Faith
feeds.description: Urban Faith is your destination for relevant and engaging conversations about news, faith, and culture.Our mission is to engage, inform, and inspire our readers through relevant articles, features, and conversations that point to the hope and truth of the Gospel.

feeds.title: After the Altar Call
feeds.description: Hello! I am Jacqueline Holness. After the Altar Call is my blog that I started in 2008. I aim to help you and me see that Christianity and faith can be found outside of a church because at some point you have to step away from the altar after the altar call and live life.

feeds.title: Bobi Gentry Goodwin Blog
feeds.description: Bobi Gentry Goodwin is a native San Franciscan. The Bay Area was where she first discovered her love for people and their stories. She has held a passion for writing since early childhood, and as a clinical social worker, her mission field has been working with women and children.

feeds.title: Hephzibah Anietoh Speaks
feeds.description: I am Chiamaka Hephzibah Victoria Anietoh and I am a Nigerian Pastor. In addition, I run this blog in conjunction with my husband Pastor John Anietoh and we are Christian writers with our first book in the pipeline presently, as well as being Christian bloggers. Join me as I share insights from the Bible regarding life, marriage, business, and most importantly our walk with God.

feeds.title: Living In Queendom
feeds.description: Get articles related to beauty, spirituality, improvement, love life and more on the blog. Living in queendom was created by Arlesia Cummings a wife, mother, foodie and follower of Christ. She encourages black women to live and love as their best selves and understand that self-improvement is a continuous journey and be ready to embark on that journey to better yourself.

feeds.title: The Urban Christian Woman Blog
feeds.description: The Urban Christian Woman blog features heartfelt essays and creative reflections aimed at restoring urban women with God's truth for everyday life, covering topics like generosity, faith in action, and Advent devotionals.

feeds.title: The Witness Inc. Blog
feeds.description: The Witness Inc.'s blog features reflections and thought pieces grounded in Black Christian identity covering topics like unhealthy church dynamics, the legacy of faith communities, and cultural commentary through podcast discussions.

feeds.title: Grounded Black Women
feeds.description: Grounded Black Women is a devotional community dedicated to helping Black women connect with God, themselves, and each other.

feeds.title: InClub Magazine » Jesus Culture
feeds.description: InClub Magazine is a Digital Magazine for Black Christian Women of today. Get to know the most relevant Black Christian news online on our website.

feeds.title: COME IN, THE DOOR IS OPEN!
feeds.description: Trust and Obey News is a platform for engaging discussions and content centered around faith, community, and values. It promotes a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere, encouraging visitors to join a community that values sharing beliefs and strengthening personal connections. The site emphasizes the importance of faith-driven principles and serves as a resource for exploring spiritual insights and practical life applications.

feeds.title: The Watchman
feeds.description: I am Awo Frank, a minister who stand in the offices of an Apostle, Prophet and Teacher. The purpose of this blog is to reach out to watchmen, intercessors, prophets across the globe to inform, teach and network to pray God's agenda.

feeds.title: God n Me Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Phillipa Williams, and in my blog, you can discover how to let the beautiful, poignant, and painful moments of life work together to fulfill God's desire to love you and grow your faith from the inside out.

feeds.title: The Church Lady Blogs
feeds.description: A Christian blog presenting the latest church news, music, church scandals, and celebrity gossip.
